pattern: たことにする / たことになる
aliases: ta koto ni suru / ta koto ni naru
purpose: Treat an event as having occurred, or state the resulting interpretation.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Vた + ことにする / ことになる
I will pretend I did not hear that.
Let’s count you as having attended today.
That means I have paid twice.
formation: Vた + ことにする / ことになる
restrictions: ことにする is a choice; ことになる describes a consequence or reckoning.
mistake: Do not confuse this past-event treatment with deciding a future action.
